description: A management liability insurance policy (directors and officers, errors and omissions, or a fund liability form): its declarations page, coverage terms and endorsements

policy_number.description: The policy number printed on the declarations, e.g. 'POLICY NO. 123456789'

policy_form_title.description: The title of the declarations or policy form, e.g. 'Investment Advisers and Funds Declarations'

insurer.description: The insurance company issuing the policy

name.description: Legal name of the issuing insurance company

location.description: City and state of the insurer as printed under its name

name.description: Name of the named insured organization

dba.description: Doing-business-as name, if one is filled in; null if blank

street.description: Street address or P.O. box line

effective_time.description: The time of day the period starts and ends, e.g. '12:01 A.M. local time'

claim_notice.description: ITEM 3: where notices of claim or loss must be sent

street.description: Street address or P.O. box line

phone.description: Phone number for questions about claim reporting or handling

coverages_included.description: ITEM 4: the liability coverages purchased under this policy

items.description: Name of one included coverage, e.g. 'Mutual Fund Liability'

coverage_details.description: ITEM 5: limits, retention and dates for the coverage

coverage_name.description: The coverage these details apply to

limit_of_liability.description: The limit of liability for all claims, as a number in dollars

derivative_investigation_expense_limit.description: The derivative investigation expense limit as printed, or 'Not Applicable'

supplemental_independent_director_covera.description: Whether supplemental independent director personal indemnification coverage applies, as printed (e.g. 'Not Applicable')

retention.description: The retention (deductible) per claim, as a number in dollars

retention_basis.description: What the retention applies to, e.g. 'for each Claim'

prior_or_pending_proceeding_date.description: The prior or pending proceeding date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD

policy_premium.description: ITEM 6: the premium for the policy period for all coverages, as a number in dollars

extended_reporting_period.description: ITEM 7: the extended reporting period option

additional_premium_percentage.description: The additional premium for the extended reporting period, as a percentage number (125 for 125%)

additional_months.description: Length of the extended reporting period in months

election_deadline_days.description: Days after termination within which written notice of electing the extended reporting period must be received, from the general terms and conditions

shared_limit_of_liability.description: ITEM 8: the shared limit of liability as printed, or 'Not Applicable'

forms_attached.description: ITEM 9: the form numbers attached at issuance, each as printed

producer.description: The producer (insurance broker) on the declarations

street.description: Street address or P.O. box line

claims_made_basis.description: True if the policy states its liability coverages are written on a claims-made basis

defense_expenses_within_limits.description: True if defense expenses reduce the limit of liability (defense inside limits)

duty_to_defend.description: True if the insurer has a duty to defend claims; false if the policy says it has no duty to defend

specified_entities.description: Funds or entities added to the definition of Mutual Fund by a specified entity endorsement

endorsements.description: Endorsements attached to the policy, one per endorsement

form_number.description: The endorsement's form number and edition as printed, e.g. 'IV-19062 Ed. 06-16'
